# The Giving Circle

> Bring your circle together to raise funds for meaningful change with verified NGOs.

> The Giving Circle is a platform designed to empower individuals and groups to champion causes and raise funds for verified non-governmental organizations (NGOs). It facilitates the creation of fundraising circles, allowing users to unite with friends, family, or colleagues to support a cause they care about. The platform emphasizes transparency and impact, ensuring that contributions directly benefit meaningful change.
This service is ideal for individuals who want to make a difference but need a structured way to organize fundraising efforts, and for NGOs seeking a reliable platform to connect with potential donors. Key use cases include celebrating special occasions like birthdays or anniversaries by fundraising, creating memorial funds, or simply rallying a community around a shared passion for a specific cause. The Giving Circle aims to make collective giving accessible, engaging, and impactful.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/): Overview of the platform, featured causes, and entry points to donate, volunteer, or fundraise.
- [About](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/about/): Who runs The Giving Circle and how causes are selected and vetted.
- [Causes](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/causes/): Full directory of active giving campaigns.
- [Stories](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/stories/): Impact stories and updates from supported projects and beneficiaries.
- [FAQs](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/faqs/): Common questions on donating, tax receipts, and how funds are used.
- [Contact](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/contact/): Contact details for donor and partner queries.

## Causes
- [Wings of Hope](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/causes/wings-of-hope/)
- [Pehli Class](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/causes/pehli-class/): Early/first-year schooling access for children.
- [Community Forest Governance](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/causes/community-forest-governance/): Forest rights and local stewardship of forest land.
- [Pawsitive Protectors](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/causes/pawsitive-protectors/): Animal welfare and street-animal protection.
- [Bowls of Hope](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/causes/bowls-of-hope/): Feeding program for animals or vulnerable communities.
- [Brick by Brick](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/causes/brick-by-brick/): Infrastructure/shelter-building project.
- [Flood & Animal Rescue](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/causes/flood-animal-rescue/): Emergency rescue and relief during flooding.

## Get Involved
- [Become a Cause Champion](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/become-a-cause-champion/): Peer-to-peer fundraising for a cause, tied to a personal occasion.
  - [Apply — Birthday](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/champion/apply/?reason=birthday)
  - [Apply — Anniversary](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/champion/apply/?reason=anniversary)
  - [Apply — In Remembrance](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/champion/apply/?reason=remembrance)
  - [Apply — General](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/champion/apply/)
- [Partner With Us](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/partner/): Corporate/CSR and organizational partnership options.
- [Volunteer](https://www.thegivingcircle.in/volunteer/): Ways to volunteer time or skills with supported causes.
